title: Detailed slice of pizza
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- Pizza crust - outer edge -->
  <path d="M 50 8 L 22 82 Q 50 92 78 82 Z" fill="#E8A84C" stroke="#D4903A" stroke-width="2"/>
  
  <!-- Crust highlight - top rim -->
  <path d="M 50 10 L 27 77 Q 50 85 73 77 Z" fill="#F0C070" stroke="none"/>
  
  <!-- Pizza sauce base -->
  <path d="M 50 14 L 30 75 Q 50 82 70 75 Z" fill="#CC3333" stroke="none"/>
  
  <!-- Cheese layer -->
  <path d="M 50 18 L 34 72 Q 50 78 66 72 Z" fill="#F5D442" stroke="#E8C030" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  
  <!-- Cheese melt drips -->
  <ellipse cx="42" cy="68" rx="4" ry="6" fill="#F8DC60"/>
  <ellipse cx="58" cy="70" rx="3.5" ry="5" fill="#F8DC60"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="74" rx="5" ry="4" fill="#F8DC60"/>
  
  <!-- Pepperoni 1 -->
  <circle cx="44" cy="38" r="6" fill="#D42A2A" stroke="#B01E1E" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <circle cx="44" cy="38" r="2.5" fill="#A01818"/>
  
  <!-- Pepperoni 2 -->
  <circle cx="58" cy="50" r="5.5" fill="#D42A2A" stroke="#B01E1E" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <circle cx="58" cy="50" r="2.2" fill="#A01818"/>
  
  <!-- Pepperoni 3 -->
  <circle cx="48" cy="60" r="5" fill="#D42A2A" stroke="#B01E1E" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <circle cx="48" cy="60" r="2" fill="#A01818"/>
  
  <!-- Pepperoni 4 -->
  <circle cx="64" cy="34" r="4.5" fill="#D42A2A" stroke="#B01E1E" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <circle cx="64" cy="34" r="2" fill="#A01818"/>
  
  <!-- Pepperoni 5 (partial) -->
  <circle cx="38" cy="52" r="4" fill="#D42A2A" stroke="#B01E1E" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <circle cx="38" cy="52" r="1.8" fill="#A01818"/>
  
  <!-- Green pepper piece 1 -->
  <ellipse cx="52" cy="30" rx="5" ry="2.5" fill="#3DAA3D" transform="rotate(-20 52 30)"/>
  
  <!-- Green pepper piece 2 -->
  <ellipse cx="40" cy="46" rx="4" ry="2" fill="#3DAA3D" transform="rotate(30 40 46)"/>
  
  <!-- Green pepper piece 3 -->
  <ellipse cx="56" cy="64" rx="3.5" ry="2" fill="#3DAA3D" transform="rotate(-10 56 64)"/>
  
  <!-- Olive 1 -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="44" rx="3.5" ry="2.5" fill="#6B8E23" stroke="#556B1A" stroke-width="1"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="44" rx="1.5" ry="1" fill="#8FAF30"/>
  
  <!-- Olive 2 -->
  <ellipse cx="62" cy="58" rx="3" ry="2" fill="#6B8E23" stroke="#556B1A" stroke-width="1"/>
  <ellipse cx="62" cy="58" rx="1.2" ry="0.8" fill="#8FAF30"/>
  
  <!-- Cheese bubble highlights -->
  <circle cx="46" cy="26" r="2" fill="#FFF0A0" opacity="0.7"/>
  <circle cx="55" cy="42" r="1.8" fill="#FFF0A0" opacity="0.7"/>
  <circle cx="42" cy="58" r="1.5" fill="#FFF0A0" opacity="0.6"/>
  
  <!-- Crust edge highlight -->
  <path d="M 50 12 L 28 77" stroke="#F8D890" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M 50 12 L 72 77" stroke="#F8D890" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
</svg>
